unit_resolution: Published Figure3F axis is lectin-positive area/CD31-positive area, not a vessel-count percentage. This resolves the provisional comparator label before numeric extraction; no outcome/contrast changes.
source_unit_basis: Paper legends specify biological replicates and count image fields within mice; source columns contain matching n. Rows are anonymous Data1 etc, not linkable mouse IDs. Retain source-reported replicate interpretation and avoid cross-endpoint joins.
source_statistics_discrepancy: Figure7E workbook lists uncorrected Fisher LSD whereas figure legend states Tukey. Do not reproduce/reuse P values or inferential stars.
